target: Immutable shadow index generations, exact source manifests, atomic active-generation switching, pointer-only rollback, and a fixed retrieval-v2.6 benchmark.
primary_semantics: Derived indexes become generation-scoped and auditable while raw history, existing CLI behavior, semantic indexes, and source authority remain unchanged.
invariants: Raw conversation and summary sources remain append-only and byte-identical.
Every indexed source is verified by exact SHA-256 before a generation can become active.
The previous valid generation remains available for pointer-only rollback.
An unexplained retrieval delta prevents activation and release.
The exact main SHA must pass Windows and macOS candidate gates before publication.
allowed_changes: Register and add Memory Plane indexing and Platform Foundation transaction modules.
Add immutable generation manifests, a shadow build path, and an atomic active pointer.
Add fixed cases MW26-GEN-001, MW26-GEN-002, MW26-RET-001, MW26-RET-002, MW26-DELTA-001, MW26-SWITCH-001, and MW26-ROLLBACK-001.
Add thin CLI adapters, synchronized documentation, release evidence, and version metadata for v2.6.0.
prohibited_changes: Modify, normalize, compact, merge, delete, or garbage-collect raw history.
Change semantic model providers or semantic index formats.
Add v2.7 background queue behavior, transport changes, Environment activation, or automatic installation.
Combine behavior-changing storage migration with the preliminary ownership-only extraction.
before_after_checks: Compare pre-extraction and post-extraction index bytes and retrieval results on the same fixture.
Compare active and shadow benchmark results and classify every delta.
Hash authoritative raw and summary sources before and after build, switch, and rollback.
Interrupt pointer replacement and prove the prior complete pointer remains readable.
Restore the prior generation without reprocessing source records.
